stories.title: Summer Career Discovery & Coaching Camp  2026
stories.summary:
Ronnie Care Foundation International successfully concluded its Summer Career Discovery & Skill Acquisition Camp 2026, a 4-week structured development initiative tailored for primary and secondary school students from both public and private backgrounds. Operating for 6 hours daily over 20 session days, the camp was designed to bridge critical gaps in youth self-awareness, career literacy, technical and soft skill acquisition, basic entrepreneurship, and foundational academic learning.

Program Overview & Participation
Exceeding our initial target intake of 20 to 30 participants, the camp successfully registered 31 unique children (14 males and 17 females). Instruction and mentorship were driven by 5 core facilitators and 3 guest experts, maintaining a robust daily average attendance of 20.26 participants throughout the four-week duration.

Weekly Curriculum & Activities
The camp followed a progressive, four-week developmental curriculum:

Week 1: Self-Awareness & Career Exploration

Focused on self-discovery, helping students identify their unique talents, interests, hobbies, values, and strengths.

Introduced traditional and emerging career paths to broaden students' horizons.

Week 2: Essential Career Skills

Explored the distinction between hard and soft skills and emphasized the vital role both play in long-term professional success.

Deep-dive sessions on communication, teamwork, and critical problem-solving.

Week 3: Career Planning & Goal Setting

Guided students through structured career planning, goal-setting methodologies, and mapping out career pathways.

Examined diverse types of occupations and industries.

Week 4: Entrepreneurship, Mentorship & Foundational Academics

Concluded the formal class sessions with modules on entrepreneurism and mentorship, equipping students to create opportunities, seek proper guidance, and sustain self-development.

Integrated foundational sessions in basic mathematics and English, specialized support for special needs children, practical cooking workshops, hygiene talks, and inspiring keynote encouragement from industry professionals.

Overall, the Summer Career Discovery & Skill Acquisition Camp 2026 fully achieved its core objectives. Participants left with an expanded view of career possibilities, a deeper understanding of their personal strengths, and practical, real-world life skills to carry them forward.

stories.title: Project ERADICATION of Silent Killers at Durumi IDP Camp
